description:
Follow-up to bd:JMAP-ly0n.16 (doc-only fix landed). The bead recommended option (a) — define typed enums for each of these vocabularies:

1. SpaceRole.permissions, ChannelPermission.allow/deny, RolePatch.permissions
   -> ChatPermission enum (9 known variants + Other(String)), backed by impl_string_enum!
2. ChatMember.role -> ChatMemberRole enum ({Admin, Member, Other(String)})
3. ChannelPermission.target_type -> ChannelPermissionTargetType enum ({Role, Member, Other(String)})
   (also tracked as bd:JMAP-pbqe — close that bead as duplicate-of-this when this lands)
4. ChatStreamEnable.data_types -> EphemeralDataType enum ({Typing, Presence, Other(String)})

Each retype is wire-byte-equivalent via Other(_) preservation. Touches:
- Type crate: new enum module(s) in jmap-chat-types, retyped fields, retyped serialise/deserialise tests.
- jmap-chat-server: delete crate-jmap-chat-server/src/permissions.rs (currently a parallel const &str canon — the workspace AGENTS.md says the type crate is canon).
- jmap-chat-client: delete or migrate crate-jmap-chat-client's parallel ChatMemberRole in src/types/ — the workspace AGENTS.md says the type crate is canon.
- Update all consumer call sites in chat-server, chat-client, and chat-server integration tests.

Decomposition recommendation: file one child bead per enum so each lands independently. Each child carries a small but real cross-crate sweep.

Doc-only fix from bd:JMAP-ly0n.16 added crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs as a const-canon for the four vocabularies. When the typed enums land, the vocabulary module can either:
(a) be deleted (the enum's own variant list IS the canon), or
(b) be retained as a public re-export of the wire strings for callers that want a Vec<&str> shape without pulling the enum

Decide (a) vs (b) per-vocabulary at sweep time.
title: Sweep: retype 5 stringly-typed vocabulary fields in jmap-chat-types as impl_string_enum! enums
